Congress to petition President over alleged venue 'purification'

Congress Members of Parliament (MPs) belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST) will petition the President regarding an alleged 'purification' of a venue in Haldwani, Uttarakhand. The incident reportedly occurred before a rally addressed by Congress leader Mallikarjun Kharge. The party claims the venue was purified after their use. The specific nature of the alleged purification and the individuals or groups responsible have not been detailed in the coverage.
